items.lede: Ukraine's strike used homegrown tech while adapting battlefield lessons from its adversary.
items.title: Ukraine blew up Putin’s bridge using relay drones to bypass Starlink limits

items.lede: Ukrainian forces ditched Elon Musk's Starlink and used a network of "flying modems" to build a relay network that allowed them to maintain a live feed of an attack on the Crimean Bridge, even as Russia tried to block the signal.
items.title: Ukraine deploys homemade 'flying modems' in daring drone attack to destroy Crimean Bridge, ditching Elon Musk's Starlink
